story.title: The Shadow Ledger
story.logline: A woman discovers that every time she tells a lie, a stranger loses a happy memory.
story.theme: The hidden cost of dishonesty on innocent lives.
story.twist: The person losing memories to her lies is the stranger who saved her life.
story.ending: If every lie steals a smile, how many strangers are currently crying because of you?

scenes.narration: I stole a stranger's childhood joy just to avoid a late fee this morning.
scenes.visual_prompt: Close-up of Elena, 25, messy dark hair, wearing a worn gray hoodie, standing in a brightly lit coffee shop.
scenes.camera: Extreme close-up pushing in fast on her face.

scenes.narration: It sounds insane, but my white lies have a literal weight. Whenever I deceive, someone somewhere forgets happiness.
scenes.visual_prompt: Medium shot of Elena, 25, messy dark hair, wearing a worn gray hoodie, staring at her phone in the coffee shop.

scenes.narration: Yesterday, I told my boss traffic was terrible. Across town, a little girl forgot her first puppy.
scenes.visual_prompt: Close-up of Elena, 25, messy dark hair, wearing a worn gray hoodie, looking down at a glowing digital ledger in her hands.

scenes.narration: I watched the tally update on my phone. One small fib equals one deleted golden moment of human peace.
scenes.visual_prompt: Medium shot of Elena, 25, messy dark hair, wearing a worn gray hoodie, sitting alone on a park bench under gray skies.

scenes.narration: So I stopped lying entirely. For three days, brutal, unfiltered truth was my only language with the world.
scenes.visual_prompt: Medium close-up of Elena, 25, messy dark hair, wearing a worn gray hoodie, talking intensely to a friend in a dim hallway.

scenes.narration: The ledger stayed at zero. No stolen smiles. No hijacked memories. I was finally healing the invisible damage.
scenes.visual_prompt: Close-up of Elena, 25, messy dark hair, wearing a worn gray hoodie, smiling faintly as she checks her phone screen.

scenes.narration: Then a terrified stranger pulled me from the path of a speeding car, asking if I was okay.
scenes.visual_prompt: Medium action shot of Elena, 25, messy dark hair, wearing a worn gray hoodie, being grabbed by a man on a rainy street corner.

scenes.narration: To save his feelings, and my own pride, I forced a tight smile and lied. I said I was fine.
scenes.visual_prompt: Close-up of Elena, 25, messy dark hair, wearing a worn gray hoodie, forcing a fake smile on the rainy street.

scenes.narration: My phone buzzed instantly. The ledger flashed red. Ten thousand points deducted all at once.
scenes.visual_prompt: Extreme close-up of Elena, 25, messy dark hair, wearing a worn gray hoodie, staring in horror at a massive red number on her phone.
scenes.camera: Rapid push-in on the screen reflection in her eyes.

scenes.narration: The man who saved me suddenly wept, looking at me blankly, whispering that he had just forgotten his own name.
scenes.visual_prompt: Medium shot of Elena, 25, messy dark hair, wearing a worn gray hoodie, watching the weeping stranger in the rain.
scenes.camera: Slow pull-back to wide, cold indifference.

caption.hook: Every lie steals a stranger's joy.
caption.title: The Shadow Ledger
caption.caption: Maya thought little white lies were harmless until she saw the ledger. Every untruth erased a joyful moment from a stranger's mind—the exact stranger who once pulled her from the wreckage.
